items.title: Shirley Lewis Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: She was more or less my guardian while my daddy was out of town.

ctx.x: No, I wouldn't say he was interested in that. Didn't pay any attention to it? No. I gather there was a lot of it when he was a boy growing up. But to say believe in it, no, no he didn't.

Because my grandmother was a very strict Catholic and she brought him up to be the same way. And you couldn't believe in both. No. And I didn't say he was interested in that.
